azure-reach.name: Azure Reach
azure-reach.subtitle: The calm frontier
azure-reach.story: A young blue sector built around Helix Station. Its trade lanes look safe, but the Broken Signal suggests an older network is waking beneath the cobalt clouds.
azure-reach.hint: Pilots report a silent object beyond North Gate that appears only when no navigation target is active.

crystal-void.name: Crystal Void
crystal-void.subtitle: Echoes in violet glass
crystal-void.story: Charged crystal fields bend scanners and preserve fragments of old transmissions. Salvagers disappear when the violet storms begin to sing.
crystal-void.hint: Some crystals respond to repair beams rather than mining lasers.

red-forge.name: Red Forge
red-forge.subtitle: Industry without mercy
red-forge.story: Foundries, pirate relays and molten dust orbit a dim red star. Every contract has a price and every faction remembers unpaid debts.
red-forge.hint: A derelict freighter crosses the western belt on an irregular cycle.

ancient-horizon.name: Ancient Horizon
ancient-horizon.subtitle: The gatekeepers' archive
ancient-horizon.story: Golden rings and deserted archives drift around a cold blue giant. The sector may contain the route used by the signal's original builders.
ancient-horizon.hint: Three inactive rings align when visited in the correct order.

event-horizon.name: Event Horizon
event-horizon.subtitle: Where maps stop
event-horizon.story: A black-hole frontier with distorted starlight and unstable routes. Only upgraded ships can survive the final approach.
event-horizon.hint: The safest path is not the shortest path.
